entities.name: Kerselin
entities.description: A pioneer port town on the edge of the Great Wood on Ulgrotha, the plane's major lumber producer.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Hijacked a vessel of families bound for Kerselin and used them to populate his Dark Barony.

entities.name: Rashka
entities.description: Famous archer who swore revenge against Baron Sengir.

entities.name: Reveka
entities.description: Wizard Savant who sailed a frigate through winter storms to bring food to Kerselin.

events.summary: Baron Sengir hijacked a vessel carrying over thirty families from Onella to Kerselin and used them to populate his Dark Barony.
events.quote: A vessel carrying over thirty families from Onella to Kerselin was hijacked by Baron Sengir

events.summary: Wizard Savant Reveka sailed a loaded frigate through winter storms to feed Kerselin until spring.
events.quote: sailed a loaded frigate through winter storms to deliver food

relations.quote: The famous archer Rashka has sworn revenge against the Baron for this heinous act.
